cell_line.evidence: miniTurboID-CRBN HEK293 Flp-In cell lines were grown in DMEM with 10% dialyzed FBS (BioConcept) and 99.0 U/mL Penicillin-Streptomycin (15140-122, GIBCO).

Frozen HEK293 cell pellets were resuspended in 1 mL / plate (150 mm) RIPA lysis buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8), 150 mM NaCl, 1% Triton, 1 mM EDTA, 0.1% SDS, added freshly 1 mM PMSF, 1:500 Protease Inhibitor Cocktail (P8849, Sigma) and 0.5 µL Benzonase (E1014, Sigma)).
